tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zab pa pod bzhi'i ngo bo nyid kyi deb bzhugs so:

lung med/ rgya gar skad du: dzā ya a khra rlu: bod skad du: grol bar byed pa'i yi ge bsdus pa zhes bya ba: rtogs pa ye shes ngang la phyag 'tshal lo: ston pa'i snying po rdo rje 'chang chen gyis: bstan pa bsdus pa'i snying po rgyud rgyal ni: bcu bdun nyid du thams cad dril nas bstan: de las khyad par man ngag ngo mtshar can: shin tu gsang ba'i yi ge rnams las ni: gdams pa'i snying po bsdus te bcud phyung ba: las dang skal bar ldan pa rnams kyi don: tshig nyung yi ge bsdus pa'i don rnams kun: sgom khrims lag len nyid dang bsdus nas ni: bla ma rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang bcud 'di: skal ldan skyes mchog snying dang 'dra ba las: blo dman theg pa dman pa'i rigs can la: rlung phyogs tsam du 'di nyid brjod pa med: rang gi rgyud la rtag tu goms par gyis: 'di las gong na thabs gzhan yod re kan: 'di ni dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying phyung ba'o: 'dir bsdus pa'i yi ge mang du yod na yang ngo mtshar can gy-i gdams ngag bzhi byung : ngo mtshar can gyi gdams ngag bzhi las ya mtshan can gyi tshig bzhi byung : ya mtshan can gyi tshig bzhi las mthar thug pa'i don bzhi 'byung ba'o: ngo mtshar can gyi man ngag bzhi ni: kha byang dung ris ma ni bltas pa tsam gyis shes: man ngag yi ge ma ru mthong ba tsam gyis rtogs: gdams pa dum dum khrigs ni bklags pa tsam gyis go: ngan sngags bsam le ma ni bsams pa tsam gyis 'grub: ya mtshan gyi tshig bzhi ni: rgyud kyi khong snying phyungs nas skal ldan mig tu bcug: rig pa spar zin byas nas nam mkha'i khams su bzhag: shes bya dum bur bcad nas yid kyis goms par bya: rnal 'byor sngags mi smra bar mkha' 'gro bran ltar 'khol: mthar thug gsang ba'i don bzhi ni: mthong ma myong bar rgyud bcu bdun gyi don dang tshig skad cig la shes shing go bas gang zag gcig gdan thog gcig tu sangs rgya ba'i don dang :

rig pa mngon sum du bstan nas snang ba thams cad dus gcig la chod pas zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po lhag ma med par 'tshang rgya ba'i don dang : sgro 'dogs thams cad dus gcig la bcad nas shes bya rang gi 'dug tshul de nyid thams cad gtan la 'bebs pa'i don dang : sngags dang gtor ma la ma brten par rnal 'byor pa bsam pa dang ldan pas 'gal byed zla ba bdun na khrag tu skyugs nas 'chi bar byed pa'i don no: de nas 'di dag ni rab tu zab par yang bstan pas: gsang ba'i thigs pa yang dag pa sbas pa'i dum bu zhes bya ba'o: gsang ba ngo bo nyid kyi debs rdzogs so: las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: gter nas gta ེ ra du btsas pa'o: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ bi ma snying thig zab pa pod bzhi'i ngo bo nyid kyi deb/ PAGE 252-PAGE 267--PAGE 266-
